summary: The change adds WebSocket RPC authenticated by one-use tickets. It covers both paths: the control-plane gateway and local development on the workspace server. Each workspace socket is replaced when its client reconnects, and is closed on a missed heartbeat, on expiry, or when too much data is waiting to send. Round 1's gaps are now closed: temp tests cover local ticket issue, a newer ticket cancelling an older unused one, expiry, reuse, CORS, and validation; the 401 rejections for missing or bad identity headers; the periodic sweep; malformed frames; and shutdown. New durable tests cover ticket expiry and sign-out. All runs pass, and the coverage gate passes with acceptable exemptions for the outage-only error handlers.
